body:
The Protection Bracelet is one of Energy Muse’s most trusted formula pieces for energetic shielding and daily balance. Designed to protect your energy field from toxic frequencies, emotional drain, and unwanted external influences, this bracelet helps you move through the day feeling grounded, supported, and energetically secure. Each element of the design works together to reinforce your personal boundaries so your energy remains intact—clear, calm, and fully yours.

At the foundation of this bracelet is Black Tourmaline, one of the most powerful protection stones in the mineral kingdom. Black Tourmaline is known for its ability to absorb, neutralize, and deflect low-vibrational energy before it enters your field. It creates a protective barrier around the body, shielding you from negativity, stress, and environmental overwhelm while helping you stay grounded and present.

Paired with Lapis Lazuli, the bracelet adds a layer of spiritual and mental protection. Lapis Lazuli has long been associated with safeguarding against psychic interference, energy vampires, and intrusive thought patterns. Its calming energy supports mental clarity, emotional balance, and inner peace, allowing you to maintain your truth without absorbing the emotional weight of others.

At the center of the formula is Copper, a powerful conductor of energy known for amplifying the protective qualities of surrounding stones. Copper strengthens intention, supports energetic circulation, and enhances the overall effectiveness of the bracelet. It helps create a cohesive, sealed field—allowing protective energy to flow smoothly while reinforcing energetic resilience.

Together, these elements form a synergistic force field that protects without isolating you. The Protection Bracelet doesn’t shut energy out—it filters it. This allows you to stay open, present, and compassionate while remaining unaffected by what no longer serves you. Whether you’re navigating crowded spaces, emotionally charged environments, or demanding days, this bracelet helps you hold onto your good energy while shielding you from the rest.

Affirmation: I am protected. I activate a shield of protection around myself to allow in only the highest vibration of good.
